messages.subject: [R-sig-Epi] SEM and Multilevel Models in R and Mplus with AI - livestream seminar
messages.subject_clean: SEM and Multilevel Models in R and Mplus with AI - livestream seminar
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone

Instats is excited to offer a 2-day seminar, SEM in R and Mplus with AI <https://instats.org/seminar/sem-in-r-and-mplus-with-ai>, running August 13?14. This practice-oriented workshop introduces structural equation modeling for researchers who want to move confidently from regression-based approaches to latent variable modeling in Mplus and R using lavaan. A distinctive feature of the seminar is its integration of generative AI tools, including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot, to support SEM coding, troubleshooting, interpretation, and reproducible research workflows in a transparent and methodologically responsible way. 

The seminar is part of a 2-part sereies on SEM and Multilevel Models in R and Mplus with AI <https://instats.org/course/sem-and-multilevel-models-in-r-and-mplus1>, with the multilevel modeling seminar running August 20?21. By purchasing both seminars, participants save 10% on their regular price. After completing the full course, you will have a full understanding of how to model complex datasets that involve multiple variables at multilevel levels of analysis ? including Multilevel SEM applications in R and Mplus.

Sign up today <https://instats.org/course/sem-and-multilevel-models-in-r-and-mplus1> to secure your spot, and feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
https://instats.org
